verdict.rationale: The GST Developer Portal (developer.gst.gov.in/apiportal) shows the product has its own API program, but the evidence shows only the portal's home, register and login pages. Nothing shows which UI functions (registration, returns, ITC, payments, refunds, appeals, notices) the API exposes. The help modules describe only UI and offline-tool workflows, so parity is essentially unproven. Missing for 10: any documented list of API endpoints or coverage, evidence that core UI workflows (returns filing, payments, refunds, notices, appeals) are exposed via API, and independent or hands-on confirmation of UI–API parity.
